ideas.title: Uncovering the Full Extent of Minnesota Fraud
ideas.description: Investigate the allegations of fraud in Minnesota's Somali community and explore the possibility of a larger pattern of fraud in the state.
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate the individuals and organizations involved
questions: What is the full extent of the fraud in Minnesota?
Who is involved and how much money is at stake?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover a large-scale fraud scheme and bring those responsible to justice. By following the money and investigating the individuals and organizations involved, we can get to the bottom of this story and provide a comprehensive report.
